scope: Native DomeD partial tracking and timestamp-consistent historical WebXR input
behavior: Retain independently meaningful head orientation, position and calibrated viewer-relative eye geometry during partial tracking loss.
Report position emulation from validity/tracking flags and use the same meaningful calibrated eye poses for projection transport.
Preserve meaningful pose components when sanitizing OpenXR transport; unavailable components remain explicitly invalid.
Keep historical action poses from consuming later predicted world positions; preserve earlier estimates within the input batch.
Clear tracking state on shutdown and preserve origin-reset and visibility behavior.

live_samples: Discord login: 30 seconds and clean close
X landing: 30 seconds and clean close; accepted QR overlap unchanged

limitations: Synthetic native transport tests do not establish physical-device or complete API/WPT conformance.
The existing independent shader-validator test requires glslangValidator; two DomeD tests require imported original assets.
Broader WebXR coverage and later rendering work remain.
